Title: FI TUNE 2.0.0 is here
Description: FI TUNE 2.0.0 brings improved playback recovery, optional lightweight glass styling, refreshed red-sun branding, a wave-style custom AOD player, and media notification polish. Get the update on GitHub.

Title: Playback fix: update FI TUNE to 1.0.4

Author: FI TUNE Developer
